title: Let devotion show up in conduct
summary: This meets the split between devotional language and lived behavior. The line refuses that split by calling religion true only when Naam and conduct stay together.
takeaway: Let Naam become visible in conduct.
lifeApplication: Before posting, promising, or advising, pause at the mouth and hands together. Choose the action that can carry the sacred words you want to say.

source.shortMeaning: Real religion keeps Naam and clean conduct bound together in one life.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking devotion, ask if the next action can bear it.

evidence.coreClaim: Real religion keeps Naam and clean conduct bound together in one life.
evidence.turn: The truest religion is clean conduct sustained by Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before posting, promising, or advising, pause at the mouth and hands together. Choose the action that can carry the sacred words you want to say.
